summary: A member checks whether a biometric reader is separate or bundled into a commonly replaced part.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). The final report describes a limited parts-pairing exception for stand-alone authentication components, distinguishing them from components bundled with screens or other commonly replaced parts.
